policy.reconfigure_when: deploy-as-is is unsafe and a changed deployment alternative satisfies every threshold
policy.block_when: no deployment alternative satisfies every threshold
policy.tie_breaker: lowest change_cost, then lowest p95 latency

limitations: Predictions are local to the synchronized workload and GKE cluster.
The initial model uses empirical counterfactual observations and is recalibrated after operational validation.
A single cycle does not establish external validity.
